g.text: Each line joins one of four test genes; black bars show means. Two guides per gene.
Fixed stimulated background; target treatment and controls are from different wells.
C3 is RNA-only, with strength 0.5 selected on four validation genes.
* GEARS uses public GO and a batch-graph adaptation; 47.5% of its raw values were projected to zero.
Training mean projected 38.9% of values; MMD and Wasserstein were not independently recomputed.
Controls are shared; genes are not biological replicates. Internal analysis, not an official score.
